blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alpha Insurance and Savouge extended their respective winning streaks to three games, boosting their semifinals chances in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Alpha Insurance hosted a block party with 14 rejections to sweep 3B, 25-16, 25-20, 25-22, and take the No.4 seed with a 4-2 record. Jetlee Gopio led the Protectors’ blocking with six blocks to finish with nine points. Reymark Betco had 10 points, as libero Lance De Castro posted 10 digs and eight excellent receptions.
